cards.back: Liu Xiu (founder of the Eastern Han dynasty)
cards.example: 刘秀建立东汉，定都洛阳。
cards.exampleTranslation: Liu Xiu founded the Eastern Han and made Luoyang the capital.
cards.breakdown: 刘：姓刘 · 秀：禾（禾）谷秀丽，美好

cards.example: 刘秀建立东汉（公元25年—220年）。
cards.exampleTranslation: Liu Xiu founded the Eastern Han (25-220 AD).
cards.breakdown: 东：东方 · 汉：汉朝

cards.example: 刘秀是西汉王室后代。
cards.exampleTranslation: Liu Xiu was a descendant of the Western Han royal family.
cards.breakdown: 王：君王 · 室：房屋，王室就是王族

cards.example: 刘秀是西汉王室后代。
cards.exampleTranslation: Liu Xiu was a descendant of the Western Han royal family.
cards.breakdown: 后：后面 · 代：世代

cards.example: 刘秀统一全国后，科学技术取得了成就。
cards.exampleTranslation: After Liu Xiu unified the country, science and technology achieved success.
cards.breakdown: 统：丝线（纟）统一起来 · 一：一个

cards.example: 西汉后期，爆发了起义。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the late Western Han, uprisings broke out.
cards.breakdown: 起：站起来 · 义：正义，为了正义而战

cards.example: 蔡伦用树皮、麻头、破布等原料造纸。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cai Lun used tree bark, hemp heads, rags and other materials to make paper.
cards.breakdown: 蔡：姓蔡 · 伦：人（亻）伦，人伦

cards.example: 蔡伦造纸是一件大事。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cai Lun's paper-making was a major event.
cards.breakdown: 造：制造 · 纸：纸张

cards.example: 蔡伦用树皮做造纸的原料。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cai Lun used tree bark as material for making paper.
cards.breakdown: 树：树木 · 皮：表皮

cards.example: 蔡伦用麻头做造纸的原料。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cai Lun used hemp fibers as material for making paper.
cards.breakdown: 麻：麻类植物 · 头：头部，这里指麻的顶部

cards.example: 蔡伦用破布做造纸的原料。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cai Lun used rags as material for making paper.
cards.breakdown: 破：石（皮）打破 · 布：布匹

cards.example: 蔡伦用各种原料造纸。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cai Lun used various raw materials to make paper.
cards.breakdown: 原：原来 · 料：材料

cards.example: 造纸促进了文化学习和知识的传播。
cards.exampleTranslation: Paper-making promoted cultural learning and the spread of knowledge.
cards.breakdown: 促：人（亻）走得快，催促 · 进：前进

cards.example: 造纸促进了知识的传播。
cards.exampleTranslation: Paper-making promoted the spread of knowledge.
cards.breakdown: 传：传递 · 播：播种，散布

cards.back: Zhang Zhongjing (famous doctor, known as the 'Medical Saint')
cards.example: 张仲景救助无数病人。
cards.exampleTranslation: Zhang Zhongjing saved countless patients.
cards.breakdown: 张：姓张 · 仲：中间 · 景：风景

cards.back: Hua Tuo (famous doctor known for surgery and anesthesia)
cards.example: 名医华佗制成了全身麻醉的药。
cards.exampleTranslation: Famous doctor Hua Tuo created a medicine for whole-body anesthesia.
cards.breakdown: 华：华丽 · 佗：人（亻）佗，人名

cards.example: 东汉末年瘟疫流行。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the late Eastern Han, plagues were widespread.
cards.breakdown: 瘟：病字旁（疒），瘟病 · 疫：病字旁（疒），疫病

cards.example: 东汉末年瘟疫流行。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the late Eastern Han, plagues were prevalent.
cards.breakdown: 流：流动 · 行：行走

cards.example: 张仲景救助无数病人。
cards.exampleTranslation: Zhang Zhongjing saved countless patients.
cards.breakdown: 助：帮助 · 救：救援

cards.example: 张仲景写出了《伤寒杂病论》，成为中医治疗学的基础。
cards.exampleTranslation: Zhang Zhongjing wrote 'Treatise on Cold Damage', becoming the foundation of Chinese medical treatment.
cards.breakdown: 治：治理 · 疗：病字旁（疒），治疗

cards.example: 后人称张仲景为医圣。
cards.exampleTranslation: Later generations called Zhang Zhongjing the Medical Saint.
cards.breakdown: 医：医生 · 圣：圣人

cards.example: 华佗制成了可以全身麻醉的药。
cards.exampleTranslation: Hua Tuo created a medicine for whole-body anesthesia.
cards.breakdown: 麻：麻木 · 醉：酒醉，这里指失去知觉

cards.back: Mafeisan (an ancient anesthetic powder invented by Hua Tuo)
cards.example: 华佗制成了麻沸散。
cards.exampleTranslation: Hua Tuo created Mafeisan.
cards.breakdown: 麻：麻醉 · 沸：沸腾 · 散：药散

cards.example: 东汉后期，爆发了黄巾起义。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the late Eastern Han, the Yellow Turban Rebellion broke out.
cards.breakdown: 爆：火（火）爆发 · 发：发生

cards.back: Yellow Turban Rebellion (peasant uprising in late Eastern Han)
cards.example: 东汉后期，爆发了黄巾起义。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the late Eastern Han, the Yellow Turban Rebellion broke out.
cards.breakdown: 黄：黄色 · 巾：头巾 · 起：起义 · 义：正义

cards.example: 在镇压黄巾军起义时，各地出现许多军阀。
cards.exampleTranslation: While suppressing the Yellow Turban Rebellion, many warlords appeared in various regions.
cards.breakdown: 镇：镇压 · 压：压力

cards.example: 各地出现许多军阀。
cards.exampleTranslation: Many warlords appeared in various regions.
cards.breakdown: 军：军队 · 阀：阀门，这里指掌握军权的人

cards.example: 东汉政权名存实亡。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Eastern Han regime existed in name only.
cards.breakdown: 政：政治 · 权：权力

cards.back: to exist in name only / nominal existence
cards.example: 东汉政权名存实亡。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Eastern Han regime existed in name only.
cards.breakdown: 名：名字 · 存：存在 · 实：实际 · 亡：灭亡

cards.back: Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases – Zhang Zhongjing's medical work
